frozenBefore: any code of the global table interpreter (1G) and before the check tables' cells were examined
purpose: a check set for the global table interpreter that is not used for its development: annotated blind by a separate Claude agent and run once, after the interpreter is frozen
tier: development-adjacent, NOT held-out: same retained pages' publishers and in part the same templates as the 18-table development sample (evaluation/tables-1e/sample.json); every page was retained and examined in earlier phases
selectionRule: tables of the 69 retained pages, not in the development sample, acquisition status complete, 2-30 source rows, at least 3 columns; one table per page, at most 2 per publisher, first in (evaluation, page tag, table index) order; for a publisher with no such table, its first 2-column table under the same rule. Chosen from structural metadata only (rows, columns, th count), never from cell text
